description: This file implements the Storage class responsible for managing task data persistence, including file existence checks, directory management, JSON serialization/deserialization, backup rotation, and file I/O operations for a task management application.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: A class handling persistent storage of tasks in JSON format, including backup rotation and cross-platform filesystem operations.

methods.name: bool fileExists(const std::string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: std::string detectDataDir()
methods.description: Detects the appropriate data directory based on the operating system.

methods.name: bool ensureDir(const std::string & path)
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: bool atomicWrite(const std::string & file,const std::string & content)
methods.description: Performs an atomic write operation to a file to prevent corruption.

methods.name: bool rotateBackups(const std::string & baseFile,int keep)
methods.description: Rotates backup files, maintaining a specified number of backups.

methods.name: bool tryParseTasksJson(const std::string & content,TaskList & out,std::string & err)
methods.description: Parses JSON content into a list of tasks, with error handling.

methods.name: std::optional<TaskList> loadFromPathWithRecovery(const std::string & primaryPath,int backupKeep,std::string & recoveryMsg)
methods.description: Loads task data from file with backup recovery options.

methods.name: std::optional<TaskList> loadTasks()
methods.description: Loads tasks from the primary data file, utilizing backup recovery if needed.

methods.name: bool saveTasks(const TaskList & list)
methods.description: Saves a list of tasks to the primary data file, with backup rotation.

methods.name: bool importFromFile(const std::string & path,TaskList & outList,std::string & errMsg)
methods.description: Imports task data from an external file, parsing JSON content.

methods.name: bool exportToFile(const std::string & path,const TaskList & list,std::string & errMsg) const
methods.description: Exports task data to an external file in JSON format.
